headline: Steady demand outlook, rising inflation key headwind

highlights: Popeyes continued to witness robust traction with 53% SSG growth in 2QFY27, with momentum sustaining into 3QFY27.
DP Eurasia performance is improving, although PAT remains impacted by MGL ( Monetary gain and loss due to inflation) and softer trends in Coffy amid rising coffee prices and stiff competition.
We have assigned 25x FY28 PRE IND AS EV/EBIDTA to standalone nos and arrive at value of Rs464/share and 22x PAT to dp eurraisa (Rs 68/share) on its CY27 earnings.
Standalone Revenues up 11.5%, LFL growth at 4.1%: Revenues grew by 11.5% YoY to Rs18.8bn (PLe: Rs18.858bn).
